prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE portrait scene for chapter 19. Image 1 shows this same place on an earlier visit (or its neighbouring coast). Preserve its architecture, palette, landmarks and spatial orientation while applying the scene below.
Earnest rustic hand-coloured woodcut on warm ochre paper: slate blue water, muted olive vegetation, clay red accents, warm black irregular cuts. Broad simpler lines, occasional knife slips, dry missed ink and imperfect colour registration. Beautiful old printed landscape, not cute, not a game illustration. Portrait 390:844 composition. No writing, borders, UI, loose inventory objects or people.
SCENE: Quiet close view of the mill pond. The SAME rust-red timber mill and now working wooden waterwheel stand far upper left, pond water across upper third runs right to left, rushes at far right. Wide pale dry earth foreground. Right pond margin reserved for separate hotspot; no microscope or study instruments.
Generous natural play space: the middle 70% of the width from 38% to 90% of the image height is a continuous empty pale ochre clearing or worn floor, with faint sparse print grain only. Keep scenery in the top third and outer margins. No clutter, strong shadows or dense hatching through this open working space. Do not draw a rectangular blank panel.
Any river keeps flowing RIGHT to LEFT.
Reserve an open natural patch centered 77% from left and 64% from top for separate hotspot art of the shallow pond margin beside the right-hand rushes. Do not paint this hotspot object twice, and do not draw markers.
